lines.text: The king and Haman dined with Queen Esther, and on the second day the king asked her petition.
Esther asked the king for her life and her people's lives, because they had been sold to destruction.
When Darius asked who had devised the scheme, Esther named Haman, who stood in terror before the king and queen.
The king went out to the palace garden in fury, while Haman stayed behind to beg Esther for his life.
Hegai told the king about the gallows at Haman's house, and they hanged Haman on it.
